{{Quote|I got the best weapons, best ship, and I'm feared across the galaxy.|Ketsu Onyo, owner of the ''Shadow Caster''|<ref name="Across the Galaxy">{{Destiny|set=Across the Galaxy|cardname=Shadow Caster|link=https://swdestinydb.com/card/08145}}</ref>}}
The '''''Shadow Caster''''' was a [[Lancer-class pursuit craft|''Lancer''-class pursuit craft]] used by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Ketsu Onyo]]. About [[4 BBY|four years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Ketsu used this starship to travel to the planet [[Garel]] during an assignment from the [[Black Sun]] crime syndicate to obtain the [[GNK-series power droid]] [[EG-86]]. There, she used the starship to pursue her former classmate [[Sabine Wren]], who had been sent by the [[Phoenix Cell]] to obtain the droid for the rebellion. After fighting, Ketsu and Sabine reconciled and joined forces to escape an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] by blowing up a [[GX1 short hauler]]. Together, they escaped on the ''Shadow Caster'' and delivered the droid to rebel forces at [[Havoc Outpost]].

A year later, Ketsu decided to help the rebellion and used the ''Shadow Caster'' to clear a passage for the rebel starship known as the ''[[Ghost]]'' to dock with the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|rebel fighter carrier]] during an [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|Imperial attack]] on the rebel fleet. Ketsu's actions enabled the rebels to unload [[fuel]] supplies which allowed the fighter carrier to refuel and flee to the safe world of [[Atollon]].

==Description==
The ''Shadow Caster'' was a fast, powerful<ref name="Blood Sisters" /> [[Lancer-class pursuit craft|''Lancer''-class pursuit craft]]<ref name="FFG post" /> that was equipped with two forward [[laser cannon]]s, a triple [[laser]] [[turret]], and a [[tractor beam]] [[Tractor beam projector|projector]].<ref name="Databank" /> It was also equipped with a [[deflector shield generator]] and a [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

==History==
[[File:Shadow_Caster_Exp_Pack_box_art.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Shadow Caster'']]
The ''Shadow Caster'' was the personal [[starship]] of [[Ketsu Onyo]], a [[bounty hunter]] working for the [[Black Sun]] crime syndicate. About four [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], she traveled to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Garel]] using the starship. There, she attempted to collect a bounty on the [[GNK-series power droid]] [[EG-86]] but instead [[Skirmish in the Garel City Spaceport|clashed]] with her former friend [[Sabine Wren]], who had joined the [[Spectres]], which was part of the rebellion. After Sabine and her [[astromech droid]] companion [[C1-10P|Chopper]] managed to escape with EG-86 on a stolen [[GX1 short hauler]], Ketsu used the ''Shadow Caster'' to pursue them and managed to knock out their hyperdrive. She also blasted their blast door open, causing Chopper to get sucked out into the [[vacuum]] of [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

Ketsu then brought the ''Shadow Caster'' face-to-face with Sabine's ship and demanded that she relinquish the [[droid]] or she would blast them. While Sabine distracted her with idle chatter, Chopper snuck up from behind and sabotaged the starship's triple laser turrent; preventing Ketsu from opening [[fire]] on Sabine. Sabine then took the opportunity to escape but Ketsu managed to capture Chopper with her ship's tractor beam projector. Taking Chopper hostage, she reiterated her demands for EG-86 and threatened to destroy the astromech droid if her demands were not met. The ''Shadow Caster'' then docked beside Sabine's stolen ship and extended a docking ring to "negotiate" with Sabine. Following a conversation, Sabine forgave Ketsu and the two former friends reconciled.<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

Shortly later, an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] stumbled upon the two ships and announced its intentions to board them. Sabine then hatched an escape plan which involved overloading the short hauler's hyperdrive while everyone else fled aboard the ''Shadow Caster''. This ruse worked and Ketsu along with Sabine, Chopper, and EG-86 were able to escape on the ''Shadow Caster'' before the short hauler exploded and damaged the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[cruiser]]. Ketsu and the rebels then flew the ''Shadow Caster'' to [[Havoc Outpost]] where they passed EG-86 to an [[Alderaanian]] group of rebels that included the astromech droid [[R2-D2]]. Having completed their mission, Ketsu dropped off her rebel friends back at Garel before parting company.<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

[[File:Shadow_Caster_XWM_Vinicius_Menezes.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Shadow Caster'' on board ''Phoenix Nest'']]
A year later, Ketsu Onyo used the ''Shadow Caster'' to assist in the defense of the [[Phoenix Cell|Phoenix rebel fleet]], which had come under [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack]] from [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] under [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]]. When Admiral Konstantine ordered his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] to stop the ''[[Ghost]]'' from delivering [[fuel]] to the rebel [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|fighter-carrier]], Ketsu used the ''Shadow Caster'' to clear a path for the ''Ghost'' to land and unload its fuel. This enabled the fighter [[carrier]] and the rest of the rebel [[fleet]] to flee to the planet [[Atollon]], with the help of information from Chopper and his friend, the former Imperial [[inventory droid]] [[AP-5]].<ref name="The Forgotten Droid">{{Rebels|The Forgotten Droid}}</ref>
